scope: Continue the fixed fresh DeepSeek cohort with the task and runtime plan unchanged.
checks: After three terminal outcomes, strict native-setting, source/network-flag, settled-cost and timing checks classify only previously inspected ten-minute timeouts or uniquely time-correlated provider HTTP 429 stream closures. Unknown errors and any flagged evidence stop the queue for inspection.
rate_limit_policy: Three provider-429 failures in one batch trigger a ten-minute hold and a bounded availability probe. Failed probes retain the hold, with at least twenty minutes before a later probe and respect for a longer Retry-After header.
outcomes: Every started model outcome is preserved without retry or replacement. The six separately recorded setup replacements are limited to the prior documented unstarted outage.

manual_upstream_stream_review.rule: The first all-three upstream incomplete-chunked-read batch was manually reviewed using unique sub-second relay/client correlations, retained without retries, and followed by a ten-minute cooldown and one bounded Max probe. This does not broaden automatic error acceptance.

amendments.change: Automate the inspected response-token-limit case only with an explicit native reason and unique two-second correlation to exactly 128000 output/reasoning tokens. Reconcile late usage only after every request settles, preserving prior run/ledger snapshots. All other unfamiliar errors still stop for inspection.
